description: Decision 3 (Cricsheet Super Over validation, validation-only), the data-quality impact register with restrictions config, preservation and no-contamination tests, run_phase2_5 orchestrator and README section. Independent of FEAT-001/002 except for app/analytics/integrity.py and reporting.py from FEAT-001.
steps: Create app/validation/__init__.py and cricsheet_super_over.py per plan 'Decision 3 procedure': official innings 3/4 summary from the read-only DB, Cricsheet index load/rebuild (reuse cricsheet_auditor.normalise_team/_record), dedupe by Cricsheet match id with directory list and copy-agreement check, mapping by exact date + normalised team pair (MAPPED_UNIQUE/AMBIGUOUS/NOT_FOUND), regulation-innings sanity checks, pure classify_super_over -> CONFIRMED_SUPER_OVER / UNCONFIRMED / CONFLICTING with reason codes, converse report for official matches without innings 3/4, evidence tables, proposed innings_role_status values (artifact only). Print and document the real representation of super_over and outcome keys from an actual file. No DB writes, no relabel.

Create scripts/validate_super_overs.py writing cricsheet_super_over_validation.json and .md (first section: validation-only, no official data changed, status fields; per-match evidence tables for the six official matches confirmed from the DB; unverifiable items; Phase 3 treatment of innings 3/4 as a per-metric restriction).

Create app/validation/data_quality_impact.py and app/validation/restrictions.py and config/data_quality_restrictions_v1.json: register entries for all 17 OPEN rows (read from v_latest_data_quality), the 5 INFO rows, and the carried-over items listed in the plan, with SQL recomputed counts, shares, classification, justification, affects, restriction, handling, phase, resolvability, blocking_detail. Quantify perturbation for the 10 mismatching innings. Never write classification into DB tables.
Create scripts/assess_data_quality_impact.py writing data_quality_impact_report.json (with issue_register section and proxy status fields) and data_quality_impact_report.md.
Create scripts/run_phase2_5.py running the four scripts in order with a combined before/after preservation check written to data/reports/phase25_preservation.json (exit 1 on any change).

Write tests/test_super_over_validation.py, tests/test_data_quality_impact.py, tests/test_no_contamination.py per plan test list (synthetic Cricsheet JSON; in-memory DuckDB from the real schema; realdata-marked tests against the real DB read-only).
Add a 'Phase 2.5' section to README.md: purpose, interpretation (proxy, PENDING_PHASE3), commands, outputs, config files, guarantees (read-only, validation-only Cricsheet).
acceptance_criteria: python -m pytest -q tests/test_super_over_validation.py tests/test_data_quality_impact.py tests/test_no_contamination.py passes
cricsheet_super_over_validation.json classifies each of the six official matches (data-derived) as CONFIRMED_SUPER_OVER, UNCONFIRMED or CONFLICTING with evidence, and reports the converse check

data_quality_impact_report.json issue_register covers all 17 OPEN rows (and the 5 INFO rows), every entry has a classification and restriction scoped to specific metrics; config/data_quality_restrictions_v1.json loads via restrictions.py
python scripts/run_phase2_5.py exits 0 and phase25_preservation.json shows no change in CSV sha256, official table hashes or Cricsheet manifests
No Cricsheet data is written to any DuckDB table or training/ranking artifact
verification: cd d:/Data/backend; $env:PYTHONUTF8=1; python -m pytest -q tests/test_super_over_validation.py tests/test_data_quality_impact.py tests/test_no_contamination.py
python -m ruff check . ; python -m ruff format --check .
findings:
FEAT-003 done. New tests: test_super_over_validation.py 16, test_data_quality_impact.py 19, test_no_contamination.py 11 (46 passed together). Full pytest 142 passed (about 145 s), ruff check and format --check clean. python scripts/run_phase2_5.py exit 0 (36 s, n_boot 1000): phase25_preservation.json unchanged=true, all 4 step exit codes 0, no CSV sha256, official table hash, DB file hash or Cricsheet manifest changed. No git commits (not a repo).
FILES: app/validation/{__init__,cricsheet_super_over,data_quality_impact,restrictions}.py; config/data_quality_restrictions_v1.json (25 rules, 26-metric vocabulary, global_exclusion false); scripts/validate_super_overs.py, assess_data_quality_impact.py, run_phase2_5.py (--db --reports-dir --n-boot); the three test files; README Phase 2.5 section. Outputs in data/reports: cricsheet_super_over_validation.json/.md, data_quality_impact_report.json/.md, phase25_preservation.json.
SUPER OVER (Cricsheet validation only; real data): representation = extra top-level innings entries with super_over true after the regulation innings; tied matches carry info.outcome.eliminator (no bowl_out seen). Official matches with innings 3/4: 6. CONFIRMED_SUPER_OVER 3 (34429 T20I, 45512 T20I, 50359 IPL), UNCONFIRMED 3, CONFLICTING 0. 40725 is UNCONFIRMED by MAPPING_SANITY_FAILED: official regulation innings 2 has 4 wickets vs Cricsheet 5; the gap equals the one official row with a dismissed player but is_wicket false (open_dismissed_player_without_wicket_flag, ball 36). Failure is kept, not waived; its Super Over fields agree with Cricsheet (context only, super_over_fields_agree_ignoring_sanity true). 48027 and 48029 (OTHER_T20, Bangladesh A) NOT_FOUND in Cricsheet, UNCONFIRMED. Converse check: 867 official matches with deliveries, 759 MAPPED_UNIQUE, 108 NOT_FOUND; 2 matches (13613 T20I 2022-02-13, 21176 T20I 2023-04-02) have a Cricsheet Super Over but no official innings 3/4 (sanity passed). Cricsheet: 7993 distinct ids in 9004 index rows, 974 ids in several directories, 0 ids with disagreeing copies, 58 matches with Super Over. Proposed statuses exist only in the JSON; official innings_role_status stays UNVERIFIED. Phase 3 rule: innings 3/4 excluded from regulation metrics by per-metric restriction RULE_INNINGS_3_4 regardless of the Cricsheet verdict.
DATA QUALITY: register has 26 entries = 17 OPEN + 5 INFO + 4 carried over (NO_RESULT/ABANDONED with deliveries 24 matches, DLS/revised 34 matches, played-XI count not 11 in 569 match-team pairs, first_innings_batting_team_id without FK with 0 orphans). The two Phase 1 items in the 17 (10 Cricsheet total disagreements, 108 unlinkable) are not duplicated. Classification: BLOCKING 0, NON_BLOCKING_WITH_RESTRICTIONS 16, INFORMATIONAL 10. Informational: squad rows without mapping row, midnight timestamps, duplicate names, unlinkable matches, the 5 INFO rows, FK note. Every recomputed count agrees with the stored row (a disagreement would auto-classify BLOCKING with detail; an unassessed new DQ row is also BLOCKING). 10 Cricsheet-total innings perturbation is computed from the Phase 1 artifact data/audit/cricsheet_overlap_report.json. Restrictions are scoped to metrics (restrictions_for_metric(name) loader, no wildcard); nothing deleted, no global exclusion. Prose counts are filled from recomputed SQL (_fill), not typed.
NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: Cricsheet loading uses data/staging/cricsheet_index.parquet (rebuilds from JSON via _record when missing); mapping = exact date plus normalised team pair, deduped by Cricsheet match id (priority ipl, it20s, t20s, bbl, cpl, mlc, india, 2026). Regulation sanity compares team, delivery count, total, wickets; competition check T20I requires team_type international, IPL requires event name Indian Premier League. Venue not compared (official venues have no names). Realdata test test_real_full_phase25_run_on_a_copy runs the orchestrator on a copy of the DB with n_boot 20. ruff format was run over app, scripts, tests. Probe scratch files in data/staging were removed.
